1: System software manages the hardware, so application software can run without knowing the details of the machine. The operating system is the main example.
2: An interrupt lets a device signal the processor when it needs attention. The processor then runs a short routine and resumes, so it does not waste time checking every device.
3: The operating system manages memory, processes, files and devices, and it provides the user interface. Each of these tasks lets many programs share one machine safely.
4: Utilities keep the computer healthy: defragmentation, backup, anti-malware and compression. They are system software because they act on the machine itself.
